description: This file defines the 'SeoUrl' controller class within the 'Opencart' admin module, handling CRUD operations, listing, filtering, and rendering views for SEO URLs in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Controller class managing SEO URL entries within the admin design module, including listing, form handling, saving, and deletion of SEO URL records.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up the SEO URL management page, including loading language, setting titles, breadcrumbs, and rendering the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests or direct calls to provide the SEO URL list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs the list of SEO URLs with filters, sorting, pagination, and view rendering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a SEO URL entry; loads existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes POST data to create or update a SEO URL record, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected SEO URL entries after permission validation.
